No owner or candidate source was changed for any of these.
key_grammar_characterization: Measured, not assumed: the v2-candidate and V2-verifier expected-work keys do NOT incorporate the owner query ref (V-key identical across query slots for the same raw fields; two declarations differing only by query slot collide at bind). Owner-query fidelity rides entirely on the claimed-key/owner-ref cross-check (H-M05fwd proves it fires) and on the producer's multi-element owner-order check. This is a documented scope ceiling, not a defect: the verifier cannot audit whether an owner query implements declared conditioning - it joins refs.
